caption: The drawing features a rectangular frame with a triangular top, resembling a shrine or altar, with a wood-like texture and brown and reddish hues. Inside the frame, five large, vertically oriented figures, each clothed in red garments with yellow and black mantles, are surrounded by radiating lines and sit within almond-shaped, flame-like auras that are outlined in black and highlighted with green and red. Each of these five figures appears to have a serene expression and a crown. At the center bottom, under the largest central figure, is a smaller winged figure dressed in red, with an outstretched arm and bent knees. Surrounding the central figures are seven green and red flower-like shapes with four or five petals each. Above the central figure are four smaller busts of individuals dressed in red, white, green, and black, shown from the shoulders up, alongside two smaller figures in the same pose as the primary ones but with different facial expressions and head coverings. The background is a light beige or yellowish color, filling the entire interior of the frame and creating contrast with the darker and brighter colors used for the figures and decorations.
title: Plate 32: Our Lady of Guadalupe: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico
